watches.name: Elastic Loop Bands
watches.description: Stretch Nylon Construction Made from high-quality elastic nylon that is soft, durable, and highly flexible. Ultra-Lightweight Comfort Designed to feel almost weightless on the wrist while providing a snug and secure fit. Hardware-Free Design Minimalist fixed-loop construction with no bulky hardware for a clean, streamlined look. Flexible Fit Elastic material naturally stretches to follow wrist movement and provides a comfortable fit throughout the day. Breathable & Skin-Friendly Soft woven nylon is breathable, quick-drying, and gentle on the skin. Sporty Everyday Style Available in multiple colors and patterns to match different outfits and watches. Built for Active Use Comfortable, washable, and durable—ideal for sports, travel, and daily wear. Simple Installation Easy to install and remove without tools. Length 27.5 cm Thickness 1.3 mm Tapered No Material Nylon No of Adjustable Strap Holes 13 Buckle Finishing Brushed Buckle/ Clasp Hardware Stainless Steel No of Removable NA Quick Release No

specsRaw.Stretch Nylon Construction: Made from high-quality elastic nylon that is soft, durable, and highly flexible.
specsRaw.Ultra-Lightweight Comfort: Designed to feel almost weightless on the wrist while providing a snug and secure fit.
specsRaw.Hardware-Free Design: Minimalist fixed-loop construction with no bulky hardware for a clean, streamlined look.
specsRaw.Flexible Fit: Elastic material naturally stretches to follow wrist movement and provides a comfortable fit throughout the day.
specsRaw.Breathable & Skin-Friendly: Soft woven nylon is breathable, quick-drying, and gentle on the skin.
specsRaw.Sporty Everyday Style: Available in multiple colors and patterns to match different outfits and watches.
specsRaw.Built for Active Use: Comfortable, washable, and durable—ideal for sports, travel, and daily wear.
specsRaw.Simple Installation: Easy to install and remove without tools.
specsRaw.Regular Cleaning: Wipe straps periodically to remove sweat, dust, and dirt buildup from daily wear.
specsRaw.Rinse After Water Exposure: After swimming in saltwater or chlorinated pools, rinse straps with fresh water to prevent residue buildup.
specsRaw.Use Mild Soap When Needed: For deeper cleaning, gently wash straps with mild soap and water. Avoid harsh chemicals or detergents that may damage the material.
specsRaw.Air Dry Naturally: Allow straps to dry naturally at room temperature. Avoid direct heat sources, dryers, or prolonged sunlight.
specsRaw.Avoid Chemicals: Keep straps away from perfumes, lotions, oils, and cleaning agents that may affect the material or hardware finish.
specsRaw.Rotate Straps: Rotating between multiple straps helps reduce wear and allows materials to recover from moisture and daily stress.
specsRaw.Leather Care: Leather straps should avoid excessive water exposure. Wipe them with a dry or slightly damp cloth and allow them to dry naturally.
specsRaw.Check Hardware & Fit: Periodically check buckles, keepers, and spring bars to ensure everything remains secure.

watches.name: Manta Automatic -Atoll Aqua Blue
watches.description: Manta Automatic is a dive tool inspired by ocean life, built with ruggedness and performance at its core. Crafted from solid 316L stainless steel , it is designed to handle demanding environments with confidence. With 200m water resistance , sapphire crystal , and a reliable automatic movement, the Manta is always action-ready. A refined mix of brushed and polished surfaces adds a premium touch to its robust construction. Purposeful in design and effortless on the wrist, it wears as good as it looks.
